title: Garage Finish
short_answer: Job Start calls garage finish a classic rework cause. How far the garage goes is sold in the packet — not decided by whoever hangs first.
summary: Job Start calls garage finish a classic rework cause. How far the garage goes is sold in the packet — not decided by whoever hangs first.
plain_words: Before you hang or finish a garage, read Garage finish on Job Start and any ceiling/wall notes. Fire-rated garage ceilings, unfinished storage, and "taped only" vs paint-ready are different jobs. Guessing the subdivision default is how we donate a remobilization.
when_to_use: Before the first board or coat in a garage
When the builder points at a neighbor's garage as the standard
Upgrade requests ("go ahead and finish it out") on a garage
prerequisites: Job Start packet — Garage finish status and related ceiling notes
Finish schedule or rated assembly callouts when the garage is rated

steps.title: Read Job Start Garage finish
steps.body: Read the status and related ceiling notes. Match the packet.

steps.title: Check drawings / finish schedule
steps.body: Rated ceiling or wall assemblies in the garage follow Fire Walls / Firestop — not habit.

steps.title: Confirm height and how far
steps.body: Walls only, ceiling, both, fire tape only. If the builder points at the neighbor's garage, that is not authorization.

steps.title: Upgrade requests
steps.body: "Go ahead and finish it out" → Change Order path.

steps.title: Cold / damp garages
steps.body: Job Conditions before mud or paint.

warnings.title: Classic rework cause
warnings.body: Garage finish and window returns are why they live on the Job Start form. The packet is the stand-behind source; habit is not.

warnings.title: Rated garage assemblies
warnings.body: Fire-rated garage ceilings and walls are listed assemblies — not "tape it like the last job." See Fire Walls and Firestopping when the set calls for rating.

quality_checks.prompt: Garage finish status read from Job Start before first touch
Height and extent (walls/ceiling/both/tape-only) confirmed against packet and drawings
Upgrade beyond packet routed through Change Order — not done as a favor

common_mistakes.title: Neighbor's garage
common_mistakes.wrong: Match the house next door because the superintendent pointed at it
common_mistakes.right: Match Job Start and the finish schedule for this address
common_mistakes.why: Authorization is in the packet, not the subdivision habit

common_mistakes.title: Paint-ready when we sold tape-only
common_mistakes.wrong: Finish and paint because "garages always get painted here"
common_mistakes.right: Stop at what the packet sold; upgrade is a CO
common_mistakes.why: Remobilization cost when the builder only wanted fire tape

common_mistakes.title: Ignoring rated callouts
common_mistakes.wrong: Treat a rated garage ceiling like standard residential rock
common_mistakes.right: Follow listed assembly and firestop hold points
common_mistakes.why: Rating failures are rework plus inspection delay
